answer: Rotating Entry Lottery. Each epoch, an unbounded verifiable random function seeded by a slow dune beacon assigns identities to entry slots; only drawn identities may act, and draws are unannounced until reveal. An attacker cannot precompute placements, so mass-registering clones yields no guaranteed slot. As the tide of registrations rises, expected waiting time per clone grows linearly. A lucky plume grants no privilege beyond one slot. Cost: sustained infrastructure plus forfeited idle epochs.
